title: 3697. Compute Decimal Representation

examples.explanation: We can express 537 as 500 + 30 + 7. It is impossible to express 537 as a sum using fewer than 3 base-10 components.
We can express 102 as 100 + 2. 102 is not a base-10 component, which means 2 base-10 components are needed.
